meta.source: Matthew Henry, A Method for Prayer (1710). Public domain.
meta.note: One head from each chapter is appointed by day of year, cycling the index.

adoration.title: Address God with reverence and awe
adoration.pray: God is in heaven, and I upon earth: therefore let my words be few. I will take off my shoes, for the place is holy.

adoration.title: Reverently adore God
adoration.pray: Thou art a Spirit, infinite, eternal, and unchangeable in thy being, wisdom, power, holiness, justice, goodness, and truth.

adoration.title: God’s eternality and omnipresence
adoration.pray: From everlasting to everlasting thou art God. Whither shall I go from thy spirit? or whither shall I flee from thy presence?

adoration.title: Perfect knowledge and unsearchable wisdom
adoration.pray: Great is our Lord, and of great power: his understanding is infinite. O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God!

adoration.title: Incontestable sovereignty and power
adoration.pray: The Lord hath prepared his throne in the heavens; and his kingdom ruleth over all. He doeth according to his will in the army of heaven.

adoration.title: Purity and justice
adoration.pray: Thou art of purer eyes than to behold evil. Justice and judgment are the habitation of thy throne: mercy and truth shall go before thy face.

adoration.title: Unchanging truth and greatness
adoration.pray: Thy word is true from the beginning. Jesus Christ the same yesterday, and to day, and for ever.

adoration.title: Heavenly splendor and glory
adoration.pray: Holy, holy, holy, is the Lord of hosts: the whole earth is full of his glory. Thou art clothed with honour and majesty.

adoration.title: Glory to God as Creator
adoration.pray: Thou, even thou, art Lord alone; thou hast made heaven, the heaven of heavens, with all their host, the earth, and all things that are therein.

adoration.title: Honor the triune God
adoration.pray: Baptizing them in the name of the Father, and of the Son, and of the Holy Ghost. The grace of the Lord Jesus Christ, and the love of God, and the communion of the Holy Ghost, be with me.

adoration.title: Dependence and obligation
adoration.pray: In him I live, and move, and have my being. What shall I render unto the Lord for all his benefits toward me?

adoration.title: Own my relation to God
adoration.pray: I will be to you a Father, and ye shall be to me sons and daughters, saith the Lord Almighty. Behold, what manner of love the Father hath bestowed upon us.

adoration.title: The privilege of drawing near
adoration.pray: Having therefore, brethren, boldness to enter into the holiest by the blood of Jesus, let me draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith.

adoration.title: Unworthiness to draw near
adoration.pray: I am not worthy of the least of all the mercies, and of all the truth, which thou hast shewed unto thy servant. God be merciful to me a sinner.

adoration.title: Desire of the heart for God
adoration.pray: Whom have I in heaven but thee? and there is none upon earth that I desire beside thee. My soul thirsteth for God, for the living God.

adoration.title: Believing hope and confidence
adoration.pray: I will trust, and not be afraid: for the Lord JEHOVAH is my strength and my song. They that know thy name will put their trust in thee.

adoration.title: Entreat favorable acceptance
adoration.pray: Let the words of my mouth, and the meditation of my heart, be acceptable in thy sight, O Lord, my strength, and my redeemer.

adoration.title: The Spirit’s assistance, and God’s glory
adoration.pray: The Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought. Whether therefore I eat, or drink, or whatsoever I do, let me do all to the glory of God.

adoration.title: Rely on Jesus alone
adoration.pray: I am the way, the truth, and the life: no man cometh unto the Father, but by me. Accepted in the beloved.

confession.title: Take hold of encouragement to confess
confession.pray: If we confess our sins, he is faithful and just to forgive us our sins, and to cleanse us from all unrighteousness. Let us therefore come boldly unto the throne of grace.

confession.title: Bewail original corruption
confession.pray: Behold, I was shapen in iniquity; and in sin did my mother conceive me. I know that in me (that is, in my flesh,) dwelleth no good thing.

confession.title: Blind understanding and stubborn will
confession.pray: The heart is deceitful above all things, and desperately wicked. I have gone astray like a lost sheep; seek thy servant.

confession.title: Vain thoughts and carnal affections
confession.pray: How long shall thy vain thoughts lodge within thee? The carnal mind is enmity against God.

confession.title: Corruption of my entire being
confession.pray: From the sole of the foot even unto the head there is no soundness. O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death?

confession.title: Sins of omission
confession.pray: To him that knoweth to do good, and doeth it not, to him it is sin. We have left undone those things which we ought to have done.

confession.title: Actual transgressions, especially pride
confession.pray: God resisteth the proud, but giveth grace unto the humble. Search me, O God, and know my heart: try me, and know my thoughts.

confession.title: Anger, love of the world, love of the flesh
confession.pray: Be ye angry, and sin not. Love not the world, neither the things that are in the world. They that are Christ’s have crucified the flesh.

confession.title: False security, fretfulness, impatience
confession.pray: Fret not thyself because of evildoers. Rest in the Lord, and wait patiently for him.

confession.title: Lack of love for others
confession.pray: He that loveth not his brother abideth in death. Let all bitterness, and wrath, and anger, and clamour, and evil speaking, be put away from me, with all malice.

confession.title: Sins of the tongue and spiritual sloth
confession.pray: If any man among you seem to be religious, and bridleth not his tongue, this man’s religion is vain. Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord.

confession.title: The sinfulness and foolishness of sin
confession.pray: Fools make a mock at sin. The way of transgressors is hard.

confession.title: The unprofitableness and deceitfulness of sin
confession.pray: What fruit had ye then in those things whereof ye are now ashamed? The wages of sin is death.

confession.title: Sin affronts God and damages the soul
confession.pray: Against thee, thee only, have I sinned, and done this evil in thy sight. He that sinneth against me wrongeth his own soul.

confession.title: Sin in light of knowledge and profession
confession.pray: To him that knoweth to do good, and doeth it not, to him it is sin. Why call ye me, Lord, Lord, and do not the things which I say?

confession.title: Sin in light of mercies and warnings
confession.pray: Despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance? Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness, not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance?

confession.title: Sin in light of corrections and vows
confession.pray: I will pay thee my vows, which my lips have uttered. It is good for me that I have been afflicted; that I might learn thy statutes.

confession.title: The condemning nature of sin
confession.pray: The soul that sinneth, it shall die. Cursed is every one that continueth not in all things which are written in the book of the law to do them.

confession.title: Glory to God for patience and willingness to be reconciled
confession.pray: The Lord is merciful and gracious, slow to anger, and plenteous in mercy. God was in Christ, reconciling the world unto himself.

confession.title: Sorrow and shame for sin
confession.pray: I abhor myself, and repent in dust and ashes. A broken and a contrite heart, O God, thou wilt not despise.

petition.title: Earnestly pray for forgiveness
petition.pray: Have mercy upon me, O God, according to thy lovingkindness: according unto the multitude of thy tender mercies blot out my transgressions.

petition.title: Plead God’s goodness and readiness to forgive
petition.pray: Thou, Lord, art good, and ready to forgive; and plenteous in mercy unto all them that call upon thee.

petition.title: Plead the merit and righteousness of Christ
petition.pray: He hath made him to be sin for us, who knew no sin; that we might be made the righteousness of God in him.

petition.title: Plead the promises of pardon
petition.pray: I, even I, am he that blotteth out thy transgressions for mine own sake, and will not remember thy sins.

petition.title: Plead my misery, and the blessedness of the pardoned
petition.pray: Blessed is he whose transgression is forgiven, whose sin is covered. Heal me, O Lord, for my bones are vexed.

petition.title: Reconciliation and peace
petition.pray: Being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ. Let the peace of God rule in my heart.

petition.title: Covenant with God and knowledge of his favor
petition.pray: I will be their God, and they shall be my people. Lord, lift thou up the light of thy countenance upon me.

petition.title: Blessing and abiding presence
petition.pray: My presence shall go with thee, and I will give thee rest. The Lord bless thee, and keep thee.

petition.title: A sense of assurance
petition.pray: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God. Give me the earnest of the Spirit in my heart.

petition.title: A well-grounded peace of conscience
petition.pray: Let us draw near with a true heart in full assurance of faith, having our hearts sprinkled from an evil conscience.

petition.title: Grace to fortify me against everything evil
petition.pray: Deliver us from evil. I pray God your whole spirit and soul and body be preserved blameless.

petition.title: Grace against Satan’s temptations
petition.pray: Put on the whole armour of God, that ye may be able to stand against the wiles of the devil. Resist the devil, and he will flee from you.

petition.title: Grace for everything good, and new life
petition.pray: Make you perfect in every good work to do his will, working in you that which is wellpleasing in his sight. Create in me a clean heart, O God.

petition.title: Grace to instruct me in the things of God
petition.pray: Teach me thy way, O Lord; I will walk in thy truth. Open thou mine eyes, that I may behold wondrous things out of thy law.

petition.title: Grace to keep me in the way of truth
petition.pray: Lead me in thy truth, and teach me. Buy the truth, and sell it not.

petition.title: Grace to bring truth to my memory
petition.pray: The Comforter, which is the Holy Ghost, shall teach you all things, and bring all things to your remembrance.

petition.title: A directed conscience, and wisdom
petition.pray: If any of you lack wisdom, let him ask of God, that giveth to all men liberally. The entrance of thy words giveth light.

petition.title: Grace to sanctify my nature
petition.pray: Sanctify them through thy truth: thy word is truth. The very God of peace sanctify me wholly.

petition.title: Faith
petition.pray: Lord, I believe; help thou mine unbelief. Without faith it is impossible to please him.

petition.title: The fear of God, and the love of God
petition.pray: Unite my heart to fear thy name. Thou shalt love the Lord thy God with all thy heart, and with all thy soul, and with all thy mind.

petition.title: A tender conscience, and God-wrought love
petition.pray: I will put my law in their inward parts, and write it in their hearts. The love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost.

petition.title: Self-denial and humility
petition.pray: If any man will come after me, let him deny himself. Be clothed with humility: for God resisteth the proud.

petition.title: Contentment and patience
petition.pray: I have learned, in whatsoever state I am, therewith to be content. Let patience have her perfect work.

petition.title: The grace of hope
petition.pray: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing. Which hope we have as an anchor of the soul.

petition.title: Grace to preserve me from sin
petition.pray: Hold thou me up, and I shall be safe. Keep back thy servant also from presumptuous sins.

petition.title: Grace to govern my tongue
petition.pray: Set a watch, O Lord, before my mouth; keep the door of my lips. Let no corrupt communication proceed out of my mouth.

petition.title: Walk wisely
petition.pray: See then that ye walk circumspectly, not as fools, but as wise. So teach us to number our days, that we may apply our hearts unto wisdom.

petition.title: Be honest in my duty
petition.pray: Provide things honest in the sight of all men. Let your conversation be as it becometh the gospel of Christ.

petition.title: Be diligent in my duty
petition.pray: Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord. Whatsoever thy hand findeth to do, do it with thy might.

petition.title: Be courageous in my duty
petition.pray: Be strong and of a good courage. Watch ye, stand fast in the faith, quit you like men, be strong.

petition.title: Be cheerful in my duty
petition.pray: Rejoice in the Lord alway: and again I say, Rejoice. Serve the Lord with gladness.

petition.title: Do my duty always and everywhere
petition.pray: Whether therefore ye eat, or drink, or whatsoever ye do, do all to the glory of God. In all thy ways acknowledge him.

petition.title: Be universally conscientious
petition.pray: Then shall I not be ashamed, when I have respect unto all thy commandments. Herein do I exercise myself, to have always a conscience void of offence.

petition.title: Wiser and better every day
petition.pray: The path of the just is as the shining light, that shineth more and more unto the perfect day. Grow in grace, and in the knowledge of our Lord.

petition.title: Support and comfort in afflictions
petition.pray: This is my comfort in my affliction: for thy word hath quickened me. God is our refuge and strength, a very present help in trouble.

petition.title: Preserving grace
petition.pray: Being confident of this very thing, that he which hath begun a good work in you will perform it until the day of Jesus Christ. Keep me as the apple of the eye.

petition.title: Grace to die well
petition.pray: Yea, though I walk through the valley of the shadow of death, I will fear no evil: for thou art with me. Into thine hand I commit my spirit.

petition.title: Grace to fit me for heaven
petition.pray: Father, I will that they also, whom thou hast given me, be with me where I am. We shall be like him; for we shall see him as he is.

petition.title: Good things of life, and preservation in calamities
petition.pray: Give us this day our daily bread. Thou shalt not be afraid for the terror by night; nor for the arrow that flieth by day.

petition.title: Daily supplies of comfort and support
petition.pray: My God shall supply all your need according to his riches in glory by Christ Jesus. Having food and raiment let us be therewith content.

petition.title: Plead the promises of God
petition.pray: For all the promises of God in him are yea, and in him Amen. Put me in remembrance: let us plead together.

thanksgiving.title: Stir myself up to praise, and thank him for his good nature
thanksgiving.pray: It is a good thing to give thanks unto the Lord. The Lord is gracious, and full of compassion; slow to anger, and of great mercy.

thanksgiving.title: Thank God for kind providence
thanksgiving.pray: O give thanks unto the Lord; for he is good: for his mercy endureth for ever. The earth is full of the goodness of the Lord.

thanksgiving.title: Thank God for his goodness continued
thanksgiving.pray: Thou openest thine hand, and satisfiest the desire of every living thing. The eyes of all wait upon thee.

thanksgiving.title: Thank God for making me in his image
thanksgiving.pray: I will praise thee; for I am fearfully and wonderfully made. God created man in his own image.

thanksgiving.title: Thank God for preserving me
thanksgiving.pray: I laid me down and slept; I awaked; for the Lord sustained me. He hath holden me up from my birth.

thanksgiving.title: Thank God for recovery from danger
thanksgiving.pray: Bless the Lord, O my soul, and forget not all his benefits: who forgiveth all thine iniquities; who healeth all thy diseases.

thanksgiving.title: Supports and comforts of this life
thanksgiving.pray: The lines are fallen unto me in pleasant places; yea, I have a goodly heritage. My cup runneth over.

thanksgiving.title: Successes and good relationships
thanksgiving.pray: Except the Lord build the house, they labour in vain that build it. Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!

thanksgiving.title: The measure of peace I experience
thanksgiving.pray: He maketh peace in thy borders. Pray for the peace of Jerusalem: they shall prosper that love thee.

thanksgiving.title: Grace to my soul, and the design of redemption
thanksgiving.pray: God so loved the world, that he gave his only begotten Son. Thanks be unto God for his unspeakable gift.

thanksgiving.title: Eternal purposes concerning redemption
thanksgiving.pray: He hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world. Known unto God are all his works from the beginning of the world.

thanksgiving.title: The appointing of the Redeemer
thanksgiving.pray: When the fulness of the time was come, God sent forth his Son. Behold the Lamb of God, which taketh away the sin of the world.

thanksgiving.title: Early indications of his gracious design
thanksgiving.pray: The seed of the woman shall bruise the serpent’s head. Abraham rejoiced to see my day: and he saw it, and was glad.

thanksgiving.title: Favor to the Old Testament church
thanksgiving.pray: Unto them were committed the oracles of God. The Lord of hosts is with us; the God of Jacob is our refuge.

thanksgiving.title: The incarnation of the Son of God
thanksgiving.pray: The Word was made flesh, and dwelt among us. Unto you is born this day in the city of David a Saviour, which is Christ the Lord.

thanksgiving.title: The Father’s owning of Christ
thanksgiving.pray: This is my beloved Son, in whom I am well pleased. God anointed Jesus of Nazareth with the Holy Ghost and with power.

thanksgiving.title: Christ’s holy life, doctrine, and miracles
thanksgiving.pray: He went about doing good. Never man spake like this man.

thanksgiving.title: Encouragement to poor sinners to come
thanksgiving.pray: Come unto me, all ye that labour and are heavy laden, and I will give you rest. Him that cometh to me I will in no wise cast out.

thanksgiving.title: The cross of Christ and its benefits
thanksgiving.pray: God forbid that I should glory, save in the cross of our Lord Jesus Christ. The blood of Jesus Christ his Son cleanseth us from all sin.

thanksgiving.title: The purchases and triumphs of the cross
thanksgiving.pray: Who his own self bare our sins in his own body on the tree. Having spoiled principalities and powers, he made a shew of them openly.

thanksgiving.title: Christ’s resurrection
thanksgiving.pray: The Lord is risen indeed. He was delivered for our offences, and was raised again for our justification.

thanksgiving.title: Christ’s ascension
thanksgiving.pray: Thou hast ascended on high, thou hast led captivity captive. I go to prepare a place for you.

thanksgiving.title: Christ’s intercession
thanksgiving.pray: He ever liveth to make intercession for them. We have an advocate with the Father, Jesus Christ the righteous.

thanksgiving.title: The Redeemer’s dominion
thanksgiving.pray: All power is given unto me in heaven and in earth. He must reign, till he hath put all enemies under his feet.

thanksgiving.title: Assurance of his second coming
thanksgiving.pray: This same Jesus, which is taken up from you into heaven, shall so come in like manner. Even so, come, Lord Jesus.

thanksgiving.title: The sending of the Holy Spirit
thanksgiving.pray: I will pray the Father, and he shall give you another Comforter. The Spirit of truth will guide you into all truth.

thanksgiving.title: The covenant of grace
thanksgiving.pray: I will be to them a God, and they shall be to me a people. This is my blood of the new testament, which is shed for many for the remission of sins.

thanksgiving.title: The Scriptures
thanksgiving.pray: All scripture is given by inspiration of God. Thy word is a lamp unto my feet, and a light unto my path.

thanksgiving.title: The ministry and other ordinances
thanksgiving.pray: He gave some, apostles; and some, prophets; and some, evangelists; and some, pastors and teachers. Not forsaking the assembling of ourselves together.

thanksgiving.title: The planting of the church
thanksgiving.pray: I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it. The Lord added to the church daily such as should be saved.

thanksgiving.title: The preservation of Christianity
thanksgiving.pray: Upon this rock I will build my church. He that keepeth Israel shall neither slumber nor sleep.

thanksgiving.title: Martyrs and confessors
thanksgiving.pray: These all died in faith. Be thou faithful unto death, and I will give thee a crown of life.

thanksgiving.title: The communion of saints
thanksgiving.pray: We, being many, are one body in Christ. If we walk in the light, we have fellowship one with another.

thanksgiving.title: The hope of eternal life
thanksgiving.pray: Blessed be the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ, which according to his abundant mercy hath begotten us again unto a lively hope.

thanksgiving.title: Every Spirit-wrought inward change
thanksgiving.pray: If any man be in Christ, he is a new creature. A new heart also will I give you, and a new spirit will I put within you.

thanksgiving.title: Remission of sins and peace of conscience
thanksgiving.pray: In whom we have redemption through his blood, the forgiveness of sins. Being justified by faith, we have peace with God.

thanksgiving.title: Powerful influences of divine grace
thanksgiving.pray: It is God which worketh in you both to will and to do of his good pleasure. My grace is sufficient for thee.

thanksgiving.title: Sweet communion in holy ordinances
thanksgiving.pray: One thing have I desired of the Lord, that will I seek after; that I may dwell in the house of the Lord all the days of my life.

thanksgiving.title: Gracious answers to prayer
thanksgiving.pray: I love the Lord, because he hath heard my voice and my supplications. Ask, and ye shall receive, that your joy may be full.

thanksgiving.title: Support under afflictions
thanksgiving.pray: It is good for me that I have been afflicted. Our light affliction, which is but for a moment, worketh for us a far more exceeding and eternal weight of glory.

thanksgiving.title: The performance of his promises
thanksgiving.pray: There hath not failed one word of all his good promise. He is faithful that promised.

intercession.title: Propagation of the gospel
intercession.pray: Pray ye therefore the Lord of the harvest, that he will send forth labourers into his harvest. That thy way may be known upon earth, thy saving health among all nations.

intercession.title: The ancient people of God, and churches in hard places
intercession.pray: My heart’s desire and prayer to God for Israel is, that they might be saved. Look upon Zion, the city of our solemnities.

intercession.title: The universal church
intercession.pray: Peace be within thy walls, and prosperity within thy palaces. Upon this rock I will build my church.

intercession.title: Conversion of those hostile to the faith
intercession.pray: God our Saviour will have all men to be saved, and to come unto the knowledge of the truth. Who will have all men to be saved.

intercession.title: Health, purity, and holiness of the church
intercession.pray: Christ also loved the church, and gave himself for it; that he might sanctify and cleanse it. That he might present it to himself a glorious church.

intercession.title: That the gospel would not be overthrown
intercession.pray: Upon this rock I will build my church; and the gates of hell shall not prevail against it. No weapon that is formed against thee shall prosper.

intercession.title: Suffering churches and the persecuted
intercession.pray: Remember them that are in bonds, as bound with them; and them which suffer adversity. If one member suffer, all the members suffer with it.

intercession.title: The nations, and my own nation
intercession.pray: The kingdoms of this world are become the kingdoms of our Lord. Seek the peace of the city.

intercession.title: National mercies and the gospel ministry
intercession.pray: I will give you pastors according to mine heart, which shall feed you with knowledge and understanding. Let thy priests be clothed with righteousness.

intercession.title: Outward peace and tranquillity
intercession.pray: He maketh peace in thy borders. Pray for kings, and for all that are in authority; that we may lead a quiet and peaceable life.

intercession.title: Moral decency and civility
intercession.pray: Righteousness exalteth a nation: but sin is a reproach to any people. He that ruleth over men must be just, ruling in the fear of God.

intercession.title: Healing of unhappy divisions
intercession.pray: Endeavouring to keep the unity of the Spirit in the bond of peace. Behold, how good and how pleasant it is for brethren to dwell together in unity!

intercession.title: Those who govern
intercession.pray: I exhort that prayers be made for kings, and for all that are in authority. The king’s heart is in the hand of the Lord.

intercession.title: Civil government
intercession.pray: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of God. The powers that be are ordained of God.

intercession.title: Those employed in public affairs
intercession.pray: He that ruleth over men must be just. Wisdom and knowledge shall be the stability of thy times.

intercession.title: Judges and judicial rulers
intercession.pray: Defend the poor and fatherless: do justice to the afflicted and needy. He hath shewed thee, O man, what is good; and what doth the Lord require of thee, but to do justly.

intercession.title: Ministers of the word and sacraments
intercession.pray: Pray for us, that the word of the Lord may have free course. And for me, that utterance may be given unto me, that I may open my mouth boldly.

intercession.title: Schools and common citizens
intercession.pray: The fear of the Lord is the beginning of knowledge. That we may lead a quiet and peaceable life in all godliness and honesty.

intercession.title: The young and the old
intercession.pray: Even the youths shall faint and be weary. Those that be planted in the house of the Lord shall flourish in the courts of our God. They shall still bring forth fruit in old age.

intercession.title: Rich and poor, enemies and friends
intercession.pray: The rich and poor meet together: the Lord is the maker of them all. Love your enemies, bless them that curse you, do good to them that hate you, and pray for them which despitefully use you.

conclusion.title: Acceptance of my prayers for Christ’s sake
conclusion.pray: Whatsoever ye shall ask the Father in my name, he will give it you. Let my prayer be set forth before thee as incense.

conclusion.title: Forgiveness for what has been amiss in prayer
conclusion.pray: We know not what we should pray for as we ought. If I regard iniquity in my heart, the Lord will not hear me: yet he is merciful.

conclusion.title: Commend myself to the grace of God
conclusion.pray: I commend you to God, and to the word of his grace. My grace is sufficient for thee.

conclusion.title: Solemn praises of God
conclusion.pray: Blessing, and glory, and wisdom, and thanksgiving, and honour, and power, and might, be unto our God for ever and ever. Amen.

conclusion.title: Sum up with the Lord’s Prayer
conclusion.pray: After this manner therefore pray ye: Our Father which art in heaven, Hallowed be thy name.
